definitions.gloss: evil deed; wrongdoing; wicked act; misconduct
definitions.explanation: Morally wrong or wicked actions. A somewhat formal and literary word used to describe seriously bad behavior or immoral conduct.

examples.japanese: {悪行|あくぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪行|あくぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに{明|あき}るみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: His misdeeds have finally come to light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪行|あくぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{悔|く}い{改|あらた}めて→悔い改める：19907_kuiaratameru⟧、⟦{善行|ぜんこう}→善行：21970_zenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: He repented of his past misdeeds and devoted himself to good works.

notes:
A compound of {悪|あく} (evil/bad) + ⟦{行|ぎょう}→行：26669_gyou⟧ (deed/conduct). Often used in moral, religious, or narrative contexts to describe seriously immoral behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪行|あくぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to pile up evil deeds
- {悪行|あくぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to commit a wicked act
- {悪行|あくぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{露見|ろけん}→露見：20077_roken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: misdeeds are exposed
- {悪行|あくぎょう}⟦{三昧|ざんまい}→三昧：05931_zanmai⟧: indulging in wickedness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪事|あくじ}→悪事：29054_akuji⟧: evil act — very similar; slightly more common in everyday use
- ⟦{非行|ひこう}→非行：03703_hikou⟧: delinquency — specifically juvenile misconduct
- ⟦{善行|ぜんこう}→善行：21970_zenkou⟧: good deed — the antonym
- {所業|しょぎょう}: deed, conduct — neutral but often used for negative behavior
